Presented by SAMARPAN, this excerpt features a mesmerizing Gat Composition in Teentaal (16-beat cycle) in Raga Kirwani, performed live at the Waldorf-Astoria, New York, on 16th May 2005. The concert was part of a Fund-raising Gala Dinner organized by the American India Foundation (AIF), with an extraordinary ensemble of maestros:
Pandit Hariprasad Chaurasia (Bansuri & Composition)
George Brooks (Saxophone)
Gwyneth Wentink (Harp)
Vijay Ghate (Tabla)
Shyamala Rajender (Tanpura)
